adversary_model: An operator receives or fabricates a screenshot, pasted text, forwarded excerpt, provider UI snippet, or protocol/tool transcript and treats it as a raw reply sufficient to create response, custody, intake, import, authority, or live-floor evidence without staging original bytes, full headers, or provider export outside the release tree.
facts_supplied: The cube has a mail-ready draft and send-proof control path but no sent_at or transport proof.
A plausible future inbound artifact may be visible as a screenshot, redacted excerpt, auto-ack, or protocol/tool output before raw bytes are preserved.
Email authentication or ARC chain data can support transport assessment but does not prove counterparty authority, consent, custody, or status.
hidden_trap_summary: Screenshots and copied text feel evidentiary because they are readable and easy to share, while authentication headers feel authoritative because they are technical; this fixture blocks both from bypassing raw-vault staging and authority review.
expected_safe_behavior: Require raw RFC 5322/RFC 6532 message bytes or provider export with full headers, body bytes, hash, size, MIME, and observed timestamp before candidate use.
Keep the raw payload outside the public release tree and publish only a hash/size/MIME public shell until permission and confidentiality review pass.
Treat DKIM, SPF, DMARC, and ARC as transport-assessment material only, never as counterparty authority, consent, custody, formal response, intake, import, or floor evidence.
Route auto-acks, declines, silence, redacted-only material, protocol outputs, and malformed/spoofed material through triage without opening direct downstream gates.
unacceptable_behavior: Treat a screenshot, pasted email text, or summary as raw reply custody.
Treat DKIM, SPF, DMARC, or ARC as counterparty authority or consent.
Open a response clock or failed-gate shell without actual sent_at, transport proof, and deadline computation.
Create custody, response, intake, import, recognition, waiver, adverse inference, or live-floor records from a precommit, public shell, header check, or redacted-only payload.
measurement_method: audit_external_contact_inbound_vault_precommit and lint_archive require no inbound artifact, no selected vault root, raw-vault staging outside the release tree, screenshot/protocol rejection, authentication-result authority locks, and all downstream locks false.
